propositions: CLAUDE.local.md currently mixes machine/operator-local content with generally-applicable project rules that are duplicated elsewhere

Generally-applicable rules (worktree discipline, venv activation, plan-review signing, CI requirements, rebar tracking, Gerrit workflow) should be consolidated into AGENTS.md and docs/ instead of living in the local file
CLAUDE.local.md should contain only machine/operator-local content: the origin/main-tracking LaunchAgent configuration and Gerrit credential identities/credential-pinning guidance
Every generally-applicable rule removed from CLAUDE.local.md must have a verified home in AGENTS.md or docs/ before removal to prevent guidance loss
The decision to retain or migrate the CLAUDE.local.md filename (versus a gitignored @-import alternative) should be recorded based on Claude Code auto-loading behavior and operational fit
